opencode-ahp `0.1.5` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@0.1.5`

## Commits
- [8962922](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/89629225ce7c047f7a95eb3d602efb0e0b031b4f) Replace plan.md with new design, futures, and testing docs (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [d763b15](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/d763b15bd60fa8f062cbabf2a69f77170882a590) Read-only terminal support (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [48e58cd](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/48e58cd1242662f3e546328453f9582f587b1c36) Update plan with history hydration and elictitation findings (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [6215499](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/6215499c2123bc197c5f5d5930956dad84be1b28) Implemented multi-chat per session (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [c7f43a9](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/c7f43a9bb29aa112263c0dfb9d9cec932b5f59ce) Implement client-provided tools (Matt Zinkevicius)
